doc: Streaming decode buffer writer. Checks whether the growing decode buffer (write pointer D_80081480) has room for a1's tile byte count (a1->unk04 * a1->unk06 * 2) against the buffer's base+size (D_8008148C + D_80080A7C); if not, resets the write pointer to the buffer base and waits for the GPU via DrawSync(0). Then decodes the object's data via func_800407C0(a0, buffer_ptr), issues a LoadImage of the header (a1) via the (possibly reset) buffer pointer, and finally advances the write pointer past the newly decoded data. Sibling of func_8004878C (same -G0 TU, same three globals, same decode-buffer idiom, slightly different size formula: this one has no +2/*4, just unk04*(unk06*2)).

globals.name: D_80080A7C
globals.decl: extern s32 D_80080A7C; /* plain 32-bit scalar: decode-buffer total size. Same -G0 TU as w_8004878C.c/code5.c; accessed via lui/%hi+lw/%lo (small-data disabled), not $gp-relative. */

globals.name: D_80081480
globals.decl: extern s32 D_80081480; /* plain 32-bit scalar: running write pointer into the decode buffer. Read and written via lui %hi/%lo pairs (no materialised base reused across accesses -- -G0 TU). */

globals.name: D_8008148C
globals.decl: extern s32 D_8008148C; /* plain 32-bit scalar: decode buffer base pointer (reset target for D_80081480 when the buffer wraps). Same -G0 TU/access pattern as the other two. */
